LENS: Dawn, the Call, the Arrival, at 2940233 (detached; worktree left clean, nothing edited, /home/user/I99 not touched). All probes and their kept outputs are in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-I99/1f0e83f4-90ea-55fd-b6c8-8fb38ca9acc1/scratchpad/m7rev-dawn/ (probe_base.gd is the shared helper; p01 to p22 are the probes).

READ: docs/CLAUDE.md; GDD 1 to 6, 7 (tables), 8.1, 9, 10, 11, 13, 15, 16, 17; DECISIONS D-023, D-026, D-028, D-029, D-046 to D-050. In full: src/core/boss_sim.gd, drive_sim.gd, hand_sim.gd, wheel_sim.gd, car_sim.gd, traffic_sim.gd, collision.gd, leg_sim.gd, item_sim.gd, effect_system.gd, nerves_sim.gd, clock_sim.gd, run_state.gd, run_generator.gd, stop_sim.gd, save.gd, gesture.gd, cabin_space.gd, event_names.gd; leg_generator.gd except the two-lane and motorcade planners (lines 1350-1415); data/legs.json, rituals.json, anchors.json, stops.json and the tuning values used; tests/test_boss.gd 1610-2625 and tests/support/cabin_suite.gd; src/game drive_controller.gd, game.gd, stand_in_bot.gd, audio.gd; the view code that reads the Call (cabin_view, hand_view, debug_hud, head of set_piece_view).

RAN (22 probes, no engine error or warning line in any run; T-BOSS-03 passes with 7,046 checks, T-CALL-01 with 96):
- Generator: 300 seeds each for no modifier and Market day: 1 attempt at most / 3 at most, no sparse or empty plan, nothing beside him in the reserved stretch, the line in the middle lane there; 100 lines per modifier driven at par by LegChecker.drive meet nothing. 300 boss seeds as a Telling derives them: 4 attempts at most, none sparse; a plan takes 25 ms on average and up to 184 ms (469 ms seen once under load), inside the tick in which he rolls into Dawn.
- Phases go by distance only: 60 s standing 5 m short of sunrise stays phase 1 (Clock +20 min); a search changes nothing. Glare ramps over 60 m to 0.6; the visor blocks 3 s (flipped again while down it is 3 s from then); Early sun from the first metre; sunglasses 0.18; tinted glass no change; the visor cannot be reached while he talks.
- Last checkpoint: 69 and 70 pass, 71 is searched (15 min, everything taken, stowed too, D-048), once only; every lane has its corridor; hands off between the barriers is five scrapes and a Wreck within 100 m (as designed); no planned lane change falls between the barriers for drivers at 70 from the sign, searched, or at 40 km/h (60 Dawns each).
- Traffic builds 4.8 > 9.1 > 12.8 > 14.5 > 18.0 vehicles per km up to the barriers, 19.7 on the Call's stretch; Market day carries 1.297 times as much.
- The Call: pulled-over thresholds exact (1.0 km/h; left side on the road's edge); alone then pulled over is free; no passenger, slow presses, the last second, no second ring, a Snap, a HOLD or the lever in hand as it rings all behave; Focus leaves the ring at 8 s of his own time. While he talks no anchor can be reached; the brake works; the thumb keypad works only with a passenger holding the phone (he grips); wrist 14.0 degrees per 100 px (40%), 19.6 with the spinner knob, Tremor and Lag apply, an armed hook is harmless. Pulled over: 29.97 s, Clock +9.99 min, tea cools, the leg's clock runs.
- call_answered: in the save at Dawn's stop, through Save.to_text/from_text into a new simulation, into arrived (call: true); a Wreck in Dawn or on the street retells with it false. The stop after Dawn exists (free pick, then the five services, no Clock cost); then the 300 m street.
- Arrival: in the bay from tail at 288.0 m exactly, at 1.0 km/h or less, across the whole width; the end of the street is a scrape above 5, a crash above 30, a head-on above 80 km/h and leaves him standing in the bay; the key works only there and once; 480.0 min is on time, 480.01 late; the street costs 6.4 to 9.7 game minutes.
- Determinism: the plan's text is identical twice for all three modifiers; 7,200 ticks of scripted input twice and replayed from the InputLog give the same state hash. No event outside EventNames.ALL was refused.

NOT FINDINGS (decided or by the GDD): the road's end hangs up, so at par the talk is 30 s less the time he let it ring (D-047); ramming the end of the street is a way to arrive (D-047); a Wreck 12 m from the house retells the night (GDD 11.4); the thinning leaves nothing to meet in the first 300 m in 22 of 100 Dawns (D-047, 'builds'); under Focus the 70 is judged on the dial (58.9 km/h over the ground).

SEEN, NOT RANKED: a TAP on the pocket let go on the tick the ring ends announces ritual_completed call_answer with nothing answered (p07, 'TAP let go 8.0 s into the ring: call=over answered=false rituals call_answer=1'): D-049's re-check on completion is not in this commit. A scrape of the guardrail within 0.8 s of the street's end swallows the hit of the end (p12 E: 1 lamp at 100 km/h instead of 3). tuning visor_view_block (0.15) is read by no code.

COULD NOT CHECK / UNVERIFIED: anything rendered (no display): whether the lowered visor covers the top 15% of the view, and the hand at his ear on screen (argued from the cabin's geometry only). Passengers beyond the cabin switch 'passenger' (M8): a Hitcher taken at Dawn's stop would ride 300 m and become a wedding guest (GDD 8.1, 11.5); the stop's hitcher service offers nothing at this commit. Tables' rules and what the wedding does with 'arrived' (M9). Touch. Whole Tellings were driven by jumping each stretch to its end, not by a human-like driver. The wall numbers of DAWN-01 are for a ghost at exactly third gear's speed after the barriers and for lane changes by the generator's own rule; a faster hand finds some lines my search does not, which is why the count of 'a vehicle beside him in every lane at once' is given beside it.

findings.gdd: GDD 9.2 rule 3: "At every point at least one lane is passable in gear 3 without a close call. The generator never builds a wall." GDD 12.4 rule 8: "The generator never builds a wall." findings.evidence: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-I99/1f0e83f4-90ea-55fd-b6c8-8fb38ca9acc1/scratchpad/m7rev-dawn/p06_wall_after_checkpoint.gd (output kept in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-I99/1f0e83f4-90ea-55fd-b6c8-8fb38ca9acc1/scratchpad/m7rev-dawn/p06_wall_100b.out): the real LegSim and TrafficSim with a ghost on the plan's line to the barriers, through them in the middle lane on a speed profile, then third gear; then a search for any line from the barriers' end to the end of the road by the generator's own lane-change rule (both lanes free for gen_lane_change 30 m). 100 Dawns, no modifier. The last line ends between 2,681 and 3,108 m, inside the Call (2,500 m on). /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-I99/1f0e83f4-90ea-55fd-b6c8-8fb38ca9acc1/scratchpad/m7rev-dawn/p06b_wall_detail.gd --seed=9: at par lane 0 is shut 2583-2630, lane 1 2475-2533, lane 2 2631-2657; after second gear lane 0 is shut 2738-2782 (truck, 60 km/h), lane 1 2770-2798 (a minibus planned at 82 km/h, now held up at 62), lane 2 2747-2826. /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-I99/1f0e83f4-90ea-55fd-b6c8-8fb38ca9acc1/scratchpad/m7rev-dawn/p06d_wall_real_sim.gd --seed=9 (the real DriveSim): at 2,765 m "lane 0: truck at 65 km/h, beside him; lane 1: minibus at 62 km/h, 2.0 m ahead; lane 2: minibus at 60 km/h, beside him; taxi at 60 km/h, 0.4 m ahead"; holding his lane he crashes at 2,769.9 m (kind 2, 2 lamps).
findings.failure: Vehicles met after the barriers are on the road long before he reaches them (trigger = meet - 300 m / closing), so every second he loses at the barriers moves the place he meets one by 42 m for a 60 km/h truck and by 204 m for an 88 km/h car, and vehicles the plan kept apart until he had passed them catch each other up ahead of him. For a driver who obeys the 70 in second gear, in about one Dawn in five a rolling wall of 60 to 65 km/h vehicles fills all three lanes at 2,700 to 3,100 m; in nearly half no line exists without braking. That is the stretch of the Call: he is on his wrist at 40%, cannot reach the lever or the horn, and the vehicles are trucks and minibuses that ignore the horn anyway. T-WALL-01 (M11) and the bot's targets rest on this rule, and T-BOSS-03 certifies a line nobody can drive.
findings.fix: Treat the end of a reserved stretch as a new start for traffic in LegGenerator: a vehicle met after the barriers is not on the road before he leaves them (trigger_s at or after the stretch's end, ahead = closing x distance to the meeting, as for a leg's first vehicles; best with a short empty run-up for the 2.5 s back to par), and no vehicle faster than the checkpoint's max_kmh is passed so shortly before the barriers that it overtakes him inside them. Then let T-BOSS-03 drive the line with second gear between the barriers instead of at par. If that is not wanted, record in DECISIONS that rule 3 ends at the last checkpoint.

findings.title: Pulled over for the Call the rough shoulder frays him 1 Nerves a second: the fourth response costs about 30 Nerves besides its 10 minutes, while standing in a lane costs none and is just as safe
findings.where: src/core/drive_sim.gd _feed_nerves (`if car.on_shoulder: nerves.add_rate(_shoulder_rate)`, also for a car at rest and for one held by boss.holds_car(), whose on_shoulder is whatever its last step left); src/core/boss_sim.gd pulled_over_safely, holds_car; tests/test_boss.gd _check_call_pulled_over checks "(and nothing else: no lamp)" but not Nerves
findings.gdd: GDD 10.4: "Pull over, hazards on, then answer | The car is stopped for 30 s: 10 game minutes". GDD 4.6: "Hazard lights ... Needed to stop safely on the shoulder." GDD 5.1 gives the shoulder as "drivable, +1 Nerves per second, speed capped at 70".
findings.evidence: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-I99/1f0e83f4-90ea-55fd-b6c8-8fb38ca9acc1/scratchpad/m7rev-dawn/p08_parked_nerves.gd. Quiet road (the empty road's calm kept out): pulled over, hazards on: taken=parked, 29.97 s, Clock +9.99 min, Nerves 30.3 -> 60.3 (+30.0); stopped in the middle lane with the brake held: taken=alone, Clock +9.99 min, Nerves +0.0. In Dawn's own traffic, seeds 1 to 5: pulled over +27.8, +18.3, +21.9, +21.5, +16.4; standing in the middle lane +12.2, -11.7, +5.3, +5.4, -13.6, with 0 hits in every case (traffic follows a standing car, D-023). From Nerves 65, pulled over: 93.2, 83.8, 87.3 at the end of the talk. /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-I99/1f0e83f4-90ea-55fd-b6c8-8fb38ca9acc1/scratchpad/m7rev-dawn/p07_call_mixes.gd part C: the parked talk crosses the Tremor threshold by itself.
findings.failure: The one response the GDD prices at 10 game minutes and nothing else also takes 16 to 30 Nerves: from the 60s he ends the call in Pound, from the 70s he Snaps while parked. Answering alone and simply holding the brake in a lane of rush traffic costs the same 10 minutes, no Nerves, no reach for the hazard button and no risk, so pulling over with the hazards on is never the right choice and the hazard lights have no use in Dawn.
findings.fix: The shoulder frays a car that rolls on it, not one that stands: in _feed_nerves scale the shoulder's rate by car.drift_share() (none at rest, all of it from drift_fade_speed up, as D-028 does for every drift), or skip it while car.speed is 0 or boss.holds_car(). Add the Nerves check to T-CALL-01's pulled-over case.

findings.title: The end of the talk has no tell: no event, nothing to hear or see; the wrist lets go on that tick, the pointer has been carried to his ear beyond the edge of the view, and the hand falls to the far right with the eyes after it
findings.where: src/core/boss_sim.gd _step_call (call_ended is set and read by nobody); src/core/drive_sim.gd _report_call (only call_missed is announced) and step() (`_wrist_on_wheel` drops, wheel.release()); src/core/hand_sim.gd step(), at_ear branch (`pointer = _space.clamp_pointer(_space.point_to_pointer(pos))`); data/anchors.json point `ear`
findings.gdd: GDD 2.2 pillar 4: "Never random at the wheel. ... Every hazard, impairment and heckle has a tell at least 1 s ahead." GDD 17.2: "Every tell has both a sound and a visual." GDD 4.2: "The pointer is a 2D position on screen." D-050 found the same for the ring ("His pocket is below what he can see, so the phone's shaking is no tell") and wrote it out; the talk and its end were left.
findings.evidence: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-I99/1f0e83f4-90ea-55fd-b6c8-8fb38ca9acc1/scratchpad/m7rev-dawn/p14_tells.gd. B: "talk ended 29.97 s after the answer; events from the answer to 2 s after its end: 0". C: "the ear is 80.7 degrees off the forward axis; the view is 107.5 degrees wide at 1920x1080, so its edge is 53.8 degrees off the axis": the hand and the phone at his ear are never on screen (and D-050 keeps the eyes from turning to them). D: last tick of the talk: pointer (1949, 655) in a view 0..1920 wide, wheel 2.8 deg gripped; 0.05 s after: wheel 0.0 deg, gripped=false; 1.0 s after with no input: hand at (1.0, -0.13, 0.05), cam yaw 23.6, pitch -10.2, and it stays so. E: with the pointer brought back at once the wheel is in his hand 0.34 s after the talk ended; over the 819 px at 2,000 px/s 0.52 s, at 1,000 px/s 0.87 s. /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-I99/1f0e83f4-90ea-55fd-b6c8-8fb38ca9acc1/scratchpad/m7rev-dawn/p19_after_parked_talk.gd (pulled over, no input after the talk): the held car pulls away by itself, 12 km/h after 1 s, 36 after 3 s; "first hit 3.23 s after the talk ended" (guardrail), 2 lamps by 6 s.
findings.failure: For 30 s after he answers alone nothing on screen or in the sound says that he is on the phone or for how long; then, unannounced, his wrist is off the wheel, the pointer is off the right edge of the screen, the hand drops toward the passenger door and the view swings 24 degrees right with it. At par the road's end comes first, so this hits whoever slowed down or pulled over: there the car, which the simulation was holding in gear, drives off along the shoulder with nobody at the wheel and scrapes the guardrail about 3 s later.
findings.fix: Announce it: about a second before the talk ends and again when it ends request a line and a sound (sfx_requested and line_requested are on the bus; call_ended is already there to read). Leave the pointer where the player had it while the hand is at his ear, or put it on the wheel when the talk ends, so that the hand comes back to the wheel. Pulled over, hold the car until the hand has the wheel again (as leaving a stop does) instead of for exactly talk_s.

findings.failure: Stuck behind a slow car in his corridor he honks (or presses the thumb keypad without letting go) and the car slides sideways through 1.16 m of concrete; his corridor is clear. The barriers are solid for him (a scrape, a lamp) and air for everyone else, and the one thing that makes a corridor a corridor, that he cannot get past, is undone by a control.
findings.fix: Nobody changes lane between barriers: give TrafficSim the stretch (BossSim.corridor()) and let begin_lane_change refuse a vehicle that is in it or would still be moving over when it reaches it; that covers the horn, the Loud horn and any planned change.

findings.failure: With the phone Habit (a call every 25 to 40 s, twice as often under a Taxi sign) a dispatcher's ring often falls inside Noor's 8 s. The player hears a second ring but the mounted phone does not light, its 5 s run out unseen: +4 Nerves and the run of answered calls for the Taxi sign's bonus is broken.
findings.fix: Leave `caller`, `ring_left` and `call_taps` to the phone on the mount always; Noor's ring is already in `call` and `call_left`. In CabinView light the pocket phone from call == "ringing" and the mount from caller.

findings.title: A car that is held is not stepped, so a touch of the guardrail on the tick before the answer stays 'touched': pulled over for the Call he is scraped every 0.8 s standing still and Wrecked in 3.2 s

findings.gdd: GDD 10.4: "Pull over, hazards on, then answer | The car is stopped for 30 s: 10 game minutes". GDD 5.6: one contact, one hit ("cannot be hit again for 0.8 s"); GDD 12.5: "Share of Wrecks from one unavoidable event: 0%".
findings.evidence: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-I99/1f0e83f4-90ea-55fd-b6c8-8fb38ca9acc1/scratchpad/m7rev-dawn/p22_held_stale_touch.gd. Control, 0.3 m off the guardrail: "taken=parked ... 30.0 s into the talk: lamps 0 of 5". The guardrail touched at 0.9 km/h on the last tick of the press: "taken=parked holds_car=true; edge_touched=1; hits so far 1", then "3.2 s into the talk: hits at -0.03, 0.77, 1.57, 2.37, 3.17 s; lamps 5 of 5; wrecked=true; the car never moved: x=12.1 speed=0.0".

findings.fix: When the car is held, clear what the last step said of the edges (car.edge_touched = CarSim.EDGE_NONE, car.wall_touched = false, on_rumble too), or give CarSim a step for a standing car that only looks at the edges.

findings.title: The photo calms again on the street of the Arrival (and on every road to a fork): 'once per leg' renews with every stretch

findings.gdd: D-049: "'Once per leg' (the photo, the charm's first scrape, statuses held for the leg) renews when a leg begins and when a boss begins, nowhere else; every save keeps it." GDD 4.6: "-20 Nerves, once per leg."

findings.failure: The photo is worth -20 twice in Act 3's last half minute (Dawn, then the street) and twice within 20 s at the start of every act; with a charm the first scrape is free again on each of those roads. Small on the street, where the floor is 0, but it is not the ruling.
findings.fix: Renew what is once per leg where a leg or a boss begins (begin_leg(), _take_fork, _begin_boss/begin_boss), not in _set_stretch; the approach and the street keep the state they are entered with, and restore() at a boss stop applies the saved leg_state as it does at a stall.

findings.title: After the key the car is not parked: with the foot off the brake it drives on through the end of the street and the Clock runs on

findings.gdd: GDD 17.2: "Every tell has both a sound and a visual." GDD 5.8 Glare: tell "The light source is visible first". D-050 applied 17.2 to the ring only.
findings.evidence: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-I99/1f0e83f4-90ea-55fd-b6c8-8fb38ca9acc1/scratchpad/m7rev-dawn/p15_events_dawn.gd part A, every event of a whole Dawn (Early sun, searched, the Call answered alone): t=45.0 s=1250 phase 2, no event; t=68.4 s=1900 {paid:search, minutes:15, taken:[arak_flask], type:pulled_over} and nothing else on that tick; t=94.17 call_started, sfx phone_ring, line call.noor.rings; t=96.47 call_resolved, ritual_completed; t=124.16 boss_ended. /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-I99/1f0e83f4-90ea-55fd-b6c8-8fb38ca9acc1/scratchpad/m7rev-dawn/p04_last_checkpoint.gd part F: the search takes 15 minutes and every piece of contraband with no sfx_requested and no line_requested.
findings.failure: A player who cannot see well gets no warning of the barriers or the sun, and any player who is searched sees the car stand for one tick, the flask gone and the Clock 15 minutes on with no word of why.
findings.fix: With the search request a line and a sound (as soldier.window does at the Checkpoint); request a sound when the checkpoint's sign comes into view and as the sun comes up, or record in DECISIONS that signs and the sky are visual tells until M10.

findings.title: At the mouth of the barriers a car across a lane line is thrown up to 1.4 m sideways in one tick, and 2.9 m from the shoulder
findings.where: src/core/boss_sim.gd walls (the taper starts at the lane's own lines; the lane is that of the car's middle, the shoulder counts as the right lane); src/core/car_sim.gd _step_edges (pushed clear of the wall by half a car and hit_pushback)
findings.gdd: GDD 5.1: "Touching a guardrail or barrier is a scrape, and the car is pushed 0.5 m back." D-047: "the car is put back at most to the middle of the corridor".
findings.evidence: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-I99/1f0e83f4-90ea-55fd-b6c8-8fb38ca9acc1/scratchpad/m7rev-dawn/p04_last_checkpoint.gd part D, all at s=1840.241: "shoulder (x=12.0): hit kind 1; in that tick the car went -2.94 m sideways (x now 9.099, lane 2)"; "line_1_2 (x=7.0): ... 1.361 m sideways"; "line_0_1 (x=3.5): ... 1.361 m"; "median_side (x=0.5): ... 0.861 m"; one lamp each.
findings.failure: Anyone changing lane as the taper begins, or trying the shoulder past the checkpoint, has run into the blunt end of a concrete barrier; the build books a scrape and snaps the car sideways by more than half a lane in 1/120 s, which reads as a glitch.
findings.fix: Meet a barrier's head as its head: a car that is across a barrier's line when the taper begins is stopped there along the road with a hit of the class of its speed (as the end of the street does), instead of being slid sideways into the corridor.

findings.gdd: GDD 10.2: "between concrete barriers 2.34 m apart (1.3 car widths)"; GDD 5.5: Truck "2.5 by 12", Tanker "2.5 by 14". D-047: "Every lane has its corridor, so traffic keeps its lanes."
findings.evidence: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-I99/1f0e83f4-90ea-55fd-b6c8-8fb38ca9acc1/scratchpad/m7rev-dawn/p18_wide_traffic.gd: "the barriers are 2.34 m apart; wider than that: {melon_truck:2.5, tanker:2.5, truck:2.5}; the Checkpoint's own queue is drawn from [car, taxi, pickup, minibus]"; "30 Dawns: 83 vehicles wider than the gap drive between the barriers in his sight, in 29 of the Dawns", e.g. seed 1: two trucks and a tanker 155 to 255 m ahead of him.
findings.failure: In almost every Dawn he watches lorries pass through corridors narrower than they are, 8 cm into the concrete on each side, moments before the same concrete costs him a lamp for a touch.
findings.fix: Keep vehicles wider than the gap off the road around the barriers: let the generator refuse, for a reserved corridor, any vehicle wider than its gap that would be inside it while within his sight; or give Dawn's road a vehicle list as the Checkpoint's queue has.
